items.description: Fullstack Bootcamp focused on Angular and Spring Boot. Hands-on learning applying clean architectures (SOLID, DDD), version control with Git, Docker containerization and unit testing. Training oriented to professional environments, problem solving and algorithmic optimization.

Development and maintenance of applications on the Odoo ecosystem: custom Python modules, dynamic views and structured reports (QWeb, XML), plus business flow automations and integrations. Analysis and resolution of incidents on production systems.

Introduction to Odoo development and feature extension through custom modules, logic design and custom views. Additionally, I contributed to the design, frontend development and layout of corporate websites using WordPress.
